---
empty: ""
citation:
  title: "{{< meta empty >}}"
author: Jane Doe
date: 2025-04-30
google-scholar: true
appendix-cite-as: [display, bibtex]
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['#quarto-citation']
        - ['meta[name="citation_title"]']
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-appendix-citeas', '.quarto-appendix-bibtex']
        matches: ['Doe']
        noMatches: ['\{\{<', 'meta empty']
---

A `citation: title:` shortcode resolving to an empty value, with no document `title`, leaves no title and no unresolved shortcode text.
